page.overview:
Who is Charlie?

Charlie was a Biosyn helicopter pilot tasked with assisting Dr. LaDonna Belvedere. Following an attack against a Biosyn installation by an InGen strike team, he and his co-pilot Ross were radioed by Bill Steingarten and told to hunt down Dr. Alan Grant's group. They left Dr.

Belvedere behind at her insistence. Quickly finding the group, they tried to strafe them but were shot down by Robert Muldoon. Although both pilots survived the crash, they were soon set upon by Muldoon. He captured Charlie and told Ross he'd "get another chance" if he shot Ross.

Thinking this meant Muldoon would spare him, Charlie promptly blew Ross away, only to be told "another chance" meant another chance at killing him. Charlie eagerly took him up on this offer and the two fought.

A big man, Charlie initially had the former game warden at his mercy, before Muldoon managed to overpower him and break his neck.
